title: 日本ダービーの後に・磨穿鉄硯

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf's dreams have been dashed, but she won't give up. Her sights stay firmly fixed on the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She resolves to prove her worth in the Kikuka Sho, but her packed schedule is starting to take its toll, and Air Groove is only getting more concerned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As usual, however, it's Symboli Rudolf's way or the highway. Even a grueling race can't keep her from her student council duties.
